fact: Citizen Digital reported on 2026-09-08 that Kenya is yet to formally join the Malabo Convention: Cabinet approved it in 2025 but it awaits approval by the National Assembly.
The African Union Commission's status list dated 2026-02-02 shows Kenya with no date of signature, ratification or accession, or deposit for the Malabo Convention (20 of 55 states have deposited).
